title: Q-RULE-gap-pages-audit: register every generated page source in /api/freshness
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** every lane pass
**Done check:** grep:site/live.js::roadmap
**Status:** open

RULES-1 gap (Rowan, 2026-11-18): /api/freshness covers only /live. Every other page fed by a generated bundle (site/*-data.js: roadmap, feed, claims, self, uiux, ultrastability, spinoff roadmap; dashboard; Practical Solutions site) must be served from live data or removed, and report its age to /api/freshness so the pages-live rule fails on a stale one.
